summary.text: R. Michael Young is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 35, which covers portions of Hendricks and Marion counties, since 2000, after serving in the Indiana House of Representatives from 1986 to 2000.
He is an attorney and political consultant.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Republican biography, Young served on the Marion County Board of Zoning Appeals from 1980 to 1982 and received a J.D. from the Indiana University School of Law, Indianapolis, in 2009.
He serves on the IUPUI Board of Advisors and is active with the Wayne Township GOP.
His listed honors include legislator of the year awards from Mothers Against Drunk Driving (2004), the Mental Health Association (2014) and the Indiana Prosecuting Attorneys Council (2020).
The page says he has three children and five grandchildren.
